_comment: Production narration for the exact-release synthetic coordinator journey. Every beat uses the deployed product; captions do not establish deployment. Merismos video schema and ElevenLabs provider contract.
_comment_length: Target 90–174 seconds, seven beats of 3–40 seconds. Measured audio, video and captions must pass the project gates before publication.

segments.captionText: Maria is a fictional volunteer coordinator in a neighbourhood food network. One offer may suit several organisations, but storage, transport and food-safety rules differ. A split without reasons can create an unsafe or uncollectable handoff. Merismos keeps the checks and collection decision together.

segments.captionText: This is the live AWS application. In a fresh synthetic sandbox, we open an editable offer, change its title and file it through the public HTTP API. The organisations and donations are invented. Nothing is published.

segments.captionText: Maria selects Work out the split. Deterministic rules run first. Eligible specialists use the Strands Agents SDK through bounded read-only tools. A bounded solver proposes each share and explains the remainder. The sandbox uses a fixed scripted tool sequence and closing answer, with no model network call.
